_how: Published with each companion release, for the red update box on thelooper.golf. importantRelease: the newest release with a bug fix that affects play; everyone on an older companion gets the box. Leave it alone for a small release. bugFix and feature: one short line each (160 characters at most); the rest goes in the GitHub release notes. null importantRelease: no box.
bugFix: Auto Aim on dull or shaded courses.
feature: Voice: arm clubs, chips and wedge flights by name, or say "retry". Auto Aim on chips and par 3 tees. Looper reads GSPro's green and course settings.
